Sunshine OS: visual and boot report

2026-11-19 · GRUB, installer, OS tools, top bar, boot log, sunshine-update · screenshots from VirtualBox (live session) and QEMU (GRUB), before and after.

1. GRUB menu broke after 3-4 entries

Cause. The installed-system theme drew the menu panel as a fixed-size image (845×497 px). GRUB paints images at file size and does not repaint them when the list scrolls, so at any resolution but its own the panel ran off the screen and was drawn over while scrolling.

Fix. The panel is now the menu's own 9-slice frame (menu_pixmap_style), which scales to the menu box and is repainted with it. Same theme for the live ISO and the installed system. Reproduced and verified in QEMU with 12–14 entries (one very long title) at 800×600, 1024×768, 1366×768 and 1920×1080, scrolling to the end.

Mistake caught on the way: my overlay→profile sync once restored the old theme (the overlay copy is canonical). The multi-resolution test caught it; both copies are now identical.

2. Installer: partitions page and summary

Problem. Calamares paints the partition legend with a hard-coded black pen (PartitionLabelsView::drawLabel, checked in its source), so on the dark theme the text was black on dark, and a cream slab inside the dark window looked wrong.

Decision (adjust the theme). The installer content area is now a warm cream with dark text; the sidebar stays dark; the orange accent is kept. Everything Calamares draws itself (legend, bars) now agrees with the theme. Also restyled: inputs, buttons, lists, the Apps tree (check boxes and expand arrows come from two small SVGs in the branding folder), tree header, scroll areas. The installer header now shows the edition version (1.5 / Sirius 0.3), not 1.0.

3. Transparency and overlapping windows

The Kvantum style Sunshine had translucent_windows, blurring and popup_blurring on; with no blur effect active, windows were see-through and overlapped visually. All three are now off (opaque windows).

4. Top bar consistency

The three top panels (menu, clock, graphs) used Plasma's adaptive opacity, so they differed from each other. All are now opacityMode = opaque (sunshine-topbar). Existing users get it from sunshine-topbar --force or sunshine-reset-plasma.

5. Boot messages visible

The whole path from GRUB to the desktop uses loglevel=6 without quiet/splash: live ISO (GRUB, loopback, syslinux and systemd-boot entries), installer (sunshine-install and the Calamares grubcfg module) and existing installs through migration 0006-visible-boot-log.sh (edits only the Sunshine default, keeps /etc/default/grub.sunshine-bak, regenerates grub.cfg). The sed was tested on sample command lines.

6. sunshine-update

  • Runs in the terminal it was started from (no second Konsole). A window opens only from a launcher (no tty) or with --window.
  • The connectivity test is no longer ICMP-only. Order: HTTPS archlinux.org → HTTPS/HTTP mirrors → connectivity-check pages (captive-portal aware) → NetworkManager state → raw TCP (1.1.1.1:443, 8.8.8.8:53, 9.9.9.9:443) → ping last. A failure says why: no route, DNS, blocked, captive portal.
  • Shared as sun_online / sun_net_explain in ui.sh; sunshine-apps uses it too.
  • The tester pushed an HTTPS-only fix for the same bug; merged, the multi-method version kept.
  • Delivered through tools release 2026.11.19.211.

7. The 22 unfinished background tasks

They were monitors of builds, installs and tests that had already completed; no builds, agents or queued notifications were running, nothing was left half-done. The VM SunshineOS belongs to the tester and was not touched. A watcher now follows new commits and issues on tak0dan/SunshineOS.

8. Open items

  • ISO rebuild required for GRUB, installer style, kernel log level and installer version (they live in the image). Tools and Kvantum changes already reach installed systems through sunshine-update.
  • Tester N1/N2: GTK theme is still Breeze-Dark and the icon theme differs between Qt and GTK. Not addressed yet.
  • Tester N3–N5: some tools lack --help; sunshine-install uses rsync --info=progress2.
  • Installed-system GRUB was verified with the real theme in QEMU, not yet through a full install on hardware.
